rules.law_name: City of Newark Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program
rules.title: HOME-assisted unit rent limits in the Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program
rules.requirement: For HOME-assisted units in the Newark Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program, rent is limited by HUD HOME rent limits during the affordability period. Rent increases for those units must comply with leases and require at least 30 days' prior written notice.
rules.key_value: Lesser of HUD fair market rent or 30% of adjusted income for a family at 65% of area median income; 30 days' notice for increases

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to HOME-assisted units in properties participating in the City of Newark Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program; applicants must be owner-occupants meeting program income and other eligibility requirements.
coverage.summary: Covers HOME-assisted units in eligible Newark owner-occupied residential structures of one to three dwelling units participating in the Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program.

rules.exemptions: Mixed use or nonresidential buildings are not eligible for the Neighborhood Rehabilitation Program; units not assisted with HOME funds under the program are not covered by these HOME rent limits.
rules.interaction: For over-income tenants, the text states they must pay the lesser of the amount payable under State or local law or 30% of the family's adjusted income, with a separate rule for low-income housing tax credit units.

rules.title: Voucher-holder nondiscrimination for HOME-assisted units
rules.requirement: An owner may not refuse to lease a HOME-assisted unit to an applicant because the applicant holds a Section 8 certificate or voucher or comparable HOME tenant-based rental assistance document.
